{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDHrnM9BXrsmw8a2RGfu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XnPKAqUcG8DnNsscEMyViW","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"import numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nDATA_PATH = \"/app/dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv\"\nNUM_COLS = [\"age\", \"bmi\", \"avg_glucose_level\"]\n\n\ndef iqr_mask(s: pd.Series, k: float = 3.0) -> pd.Series:\n    q1, q3 = s.quantile([0.25, 0.75])\n    iqr = q3 - q1\n    return (s < q1 - k * iqr) | (s > q3 + k * iqr)\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[int]:\n    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n    # Keep the original positional index (first row = 0) mapped to the unique patient_id\n    id_to_idx = pd.Series(df.index, index=df[\"patient_id\"])\n\n    # 1. Technical noise: physically impossible values\n    noise = (\n        ~df[\"avg_glucose_level\"].between(20, 800)\n        | ~df[\"bmi\"].between(10, 60)\n        | (df[\"age\"] > 120)\n    )\n    noise_ids = df.loc[noise, \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n    d = df.loc[~noise].copy()\n\n    # 2. Risk proxy: product of max-normalized numerical features\n    d[\"risk_proxy\"] = np.prod([d[c] / d[c].max() for c in NUM_COLS], axis=0)\n\n    # 4. Mahalanobis distance in the numerical feature space\n    feats = NUM_COLS + [\"risk_proxy\"]\n    X = d[feats].to_numpy()\n    diff = X - X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    d2 = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    crit = chi2.ppf(1 - 0.01, df=len(feats))\n    maha_ids = d.loc[d2 > crit, \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n\n    # 5. Implausible categorical combinations\n    smoker = d[\"smoking_status\"].isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"])\n    child = d[\"age\"] <= 14\n    toddler = d[\"age\"] <= 3\n    cat_mask = (\n        (smoker & child)\n        | (smoker & (d[\"work_type\"] == \"children\"))\n        | (toddler & (d[\"work_type\"] == \"student\"))\n    )\n    cat_ids = d.loc[cat_mask, \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n\n    result = []\n    seen = set()\n    for pid in noise_ids + iqr_ids + maha_ids + cat_ids:\n        idx = int(id_to_idx[pid])\n        if idx not in seen:\n            seen.add(idx)\n            result.append(idx)\n    return result\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":494,"cache_read_input_tokens":31129,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":494,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bd9e3152-0b46-410a-854d-7a9030f69bc9","uuid":"7d00d76f-8602-4d62-a2dd-64a55da5ec11","timestamp":"2026-10-20T09:58:24.139Z"}
